projects.title: GMG SaaS Platform Modernization
projects.description: Contributed to the architecture decision and led execution of the migration of mission-critical multi-tenant SaaS software from .NET Framework to .NET 8, including local data storage migration from SQL CE to SQLite. Resolved complex legacy constraints across a large commercial codebase while keeping the production platform stable throughout the transition.

projects.title: Printer Hardware IPC Integration
projects.description: Designed and built the full IPC layer between SaaS software and professional printer hardware, choosing Named Pipes and socket networking as the communication approach at GMG. Enables reliable real-time hardware-software communication and eliminates race conditions in hardware interaction.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Authorization Platform
projects.description: Architected RESTful APIs with OAuth2 and JWT authentication, and implemented fine-grained multi-tenant authorization using Authzed (Google Zanzibar-inspired model) at GMG — enabling complex cross-tenant permission requirements for a commercial SaaS platform.

projects.title: MCP Server with RAG-Indexed Codebase
projects.description: Built an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with RAG-indexed codebase routes to support AI-assisted development at GMG. Makes it easier for engineers to navigate complex legacy code and significantly speeds up onboarding to the platform.

projects.title: OSS Licence Detection & Compliance Automation
projects.description: Solely designed and built an automated OSS licence-compliance tool at GMG covering 3 applications and their transitive dependencies (57+ NuGet packages in the main app alone). Validates every package against approved licence policy, auto-generates copyright notices, an acknowledgement file, and an SBOM, and is wired into the CI pipeline to block any unreviewed package from shipping — eliminating manual legal review.

projects.title: Enterprise Analytics & Regulatory Reporting Platform
projects.description: Sole architect and technical lead of a regulatory-grade BI and reporting platform (React.js, Node.js, Docker, microservices) aggregating real-time transaction data across Postbank of Iran (PBI)'s core banking, 400+ branches, ATM, and POS networks. Extended the platform with a structured API layer for external BI tools and a React Native companion app for on-the-go branch-level reporting. Used by senior management and submitted directly to Central Bank regulators.

projects.title: Banking ETL & Regulatory Data Pipelines
projects.description: Designed custom Node.js and SQL Server ETL pipelines processing high-volume transactional data from multiple operational banking sources at PBI. Enforced data validation rules where inaccuracies carried direct legal and financial consequences for Central Bank submissions.

projects.title: Amitis Hamta FinTech Platform
projects.description: Software architecture consultant for Amitis Hamta Co., providing strategic guidance on full-stack architecture and building a secure payment panel integration for their fintech platform. Covered API design, payment flows, and end-to-end system architecture.

projects.title: Shetab National Card Network Integration
projects.description: Spearheaded R&D and architectural design for the Shetab national card network integration at PBI — engineering Java-based high-availability services for real-time national payment transaction processing at scale.

projects.title: Chakavak National Cheque-Clearing Backbone
projects.description: Architected the IBM MQ messaging backbone for PBI's Chakavak national cheque-clearing system, achieving fault-tolerant asynchronous processing across distributed nodes under strict Central Bank regulatory SLAs.

projects.title: Core Banking Platform — 15,000 Concurrent Users
projects.description: Architected and delivered a full-scope core banking platform (.NET, C#) spanning Accounting, Treasury, HR, Branch Operations, and Supervisor workflows — deployed on a 15-node distributed SQL Server cluster serving 15,000 concurrent users with ACID-compliant transactional isolation.

projects.title: POS Terminal & ATM Integration Software
projects.description: Developed C++ POS terminal software with hardware-level protocol integration, and ATM/card processing modules with real-time authorisation and settlement flows at PBI.
